answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch a lottery audits 5% of identities; each must show proof of real work, checked by 3 random peers. A fake faces a canyon: no real history means failure and a lost 25-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 credits, and each failure raises audit odds so the cost spirals upward. An honest agent pays one bond, refunded on passing, and keeps its full share of the meadow.
